purpose: Exploratory comparison of monthly Suomi-NPP counts calibrated to Terra counts; no runtime data replacement
benchmark_status: Previously inspected; not an untouched confirmatory test
solar_period: Approximate local solar hour = (UTC hour + minute/60 + longitude/15) modulo 24; day = [06,18), night = remaining hours. This is an acquisition-time proxy, not a quality illumination mask or observation denominator.
quarter_ratio: For each quarter: (quarter Terra total + prior_fraction * all Terra total / 4) / (quarter VIIRS total + prior_fraction * all VIIRS total / 4).
solar_ratio: For each solar period: (period Terra total + prior_fraction * all Terra total / 2) / (period VIIRS total + prior_fraction * all VIIRS total / 2); sum the two scaled source counts.
poisson: log(mu) = intercept + slope*log(1+VIIRS) [+ sine*sin(2*pi*(month-1)/12) + cosine*cos(2*pi*(month-1)/12)]. Minimize mean(mu-y*log(mu)) + penalty/2*((slope-1)^2 + sine^2 + cosine^2). Intercept is unpenalized. No probabilistic uncertainty claim; counts may be overdispersed.
limitations: Candidate definitions follow inspection of the existing benchmark; this is exploratory despite restricting model selection to training years.
All candidates use the same months and original qualifying source counts. Missing counts are not replaced with zero.
The source archive has detection points, not verified cloud-free observation opportunities or full pixel footprints.
Solar period matching does not make Terra and VIIRS overpasses simultaneous.
An observed peak-month diagnostic is evaluated after predictions are frozen; peak months are not model features.
No chart smoothing, peak shifting, target-reference change, new data exclusion or replacement of the published record is performed.
